item.title: auto progress denominator goes stale after auto-groom adds new items mid-session
item.intent: The progress counter denominator must reflect the actual number of items available for the session at the time of display, not a snapshot taken at session start that becomes wrong after auto-groom fires.
item.description: setup_sprint_environment() builds queued_ids once before the sprint loop via list_pickable_ids(). The progress line 'X/${#queued_ids[@]} complete' uses this pre-session count as denominator. When auto-groom fires mid-session (ready < AUTO_GROOM_THRESHOLD), it can add new items to the backlog. These new items are picked by pick_item() in subsequent loops (since pick_item queries the live backlog), but they were never added to queued_ids. The denominator stays fixed, so passed can exceed it (e.g. '6/5 complete') or the denominator is just misleading. The fix is to recompute display_total from list_pickable_ids(skip_list) after groom completes, so the denominator always reflects current reality.
steps: After auto-groom runs in the sprint loop (the block around line 2870-2883), call list_pickable_ids with the current skip_list and priority filter to get updated_ids
Append any IDs in updated_ids that are not already in queued_ids (or not in skipped_ids/completed) to queued_ids
Recompute display_total from the updated queued_ids length (already capped by session_limit)
Verify: a session that auto-grooms shows accurate denominator after groom adds new items
acceptanceCriteria: When auto-groom fires and adds 3 new items during a session, the progress denominator increases to include them
passed never exceeds display_total during a normal session
session_limit cap is still respected: display_total does not exceed session_limit when one is set
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
